name: r2-dispatch-manual-cloud
_comment: Cloud broker traffic of accepted manual STREGA commands (open, CLOSE, CLOSE_FOR_DURATION, an open of a valve last reported open) and of an open while the account-recovery journal blocks cloud MQTT.

steps.why: STREGA valves for each accepted manual action; A840410000000024 last reported OPEN.
